mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.comment_count, p.like_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, m.id AS author_id, m.display_name AS author_name, m.avatar_url AS author_avatar FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id

WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_stock ps WHERE ps.post_id = p.id AND ps.stock_id = #{stockId})
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT post_id, stock_id FROM post_stock WHERE post_id IN #{postId} ORDER BY post_id, stock_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (member_id, title, content, comment_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{author.id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{commentCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_like (post_id, member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
